name: Domain Watch
description: 域名监控插件：基于 RDAP 协议的 Whois 查询与域名续费到期提醒。
author: Geekertao

help.zh_CN: 要监控的域名列表，用逗号分隔，例如：example.com, example.org
help.en: Comma-separated domains to monitor, e.g.: example.com, example.org

help.zh_CN: 距到期日小于等于该天数时发送提醒（默认 30）
help.en: Notify when days left to expiration is less than or equal to this (default 30)

help.zh_CN: 域名过期后发送一次提醒：已进入删除期，可续费赎回或关注抢注
help.en: Send one alert after a domain expires: in the deletion period, can renew/redemption or watch for backorder

help.zh_CN: 每日检查的 cron 表达式（分 时 日 月 周），修改后需重启插件生效
help.en: Cron expression for daily check (min hour day month weekday). Restart the plugin after change.

help.zh_CN: 在下方的测试按钮发送一条测试通知到已配置的通知渠道
help.en: Click the test button below to send a test notification to configured channels

name.zh_CN: 推荐的域名比价平台：tldes.com、nazhumi.com、miqingju.com、tld-list.com。同类平台还有很多，只要善用搜索引擎即可找到，我们无法全部列出。
name.en: Recommended domain price comparison platforms: tldes.com, nazhumi.com, miqingju.com, tld-list.com. There are many similar platforms; just search and you will find them. We cannot list them all.
